_comment: Revenue-type breakdown for charges that carry NO INVOICE, so build_revenue_recognition has no line items to allocate from. One-off and manually-created charges land here: Stripe records a single amount with a free-text description, and nothing in the payload says what was sold. Key by charge id (ch_/py_) or balance-transaction id (txn_). Line amounts must sum to the charge gross; the builder refuses an override that does not reconcile rather than silently mis-stating revenue. revenue_type must be one of the types in product_revenue_types.json.

ch_3UMDkIHkM2QhTtxh0bWuGHIJ.note: Beau, 2026-10-07, from the Stripe pricing screen. Taken as a single one-off charge — the customer has no subscription object, so there is no invoice and no line items to read. Once they are moved onto a subscription the normal per-line allocation takes over and this override stops being used.

py_3Sz1u3HkM2QhTtxh10uCzuu1.note: One-off charge taken 2026-02-09 before the customer was put on a subscription. Their live subscription sub_1T9BG2Hk is a single $417 Core Software line (prod_RthYPv0w7cEotz) — same amount, same product — so this is plain subscription revenue. Verified against Stripe, not inferred from the description.
